name: restaurant-saas-monorepo
description: Restaurant SaaS Multi-tenant System with Org Admin, POS, Line-Mode KDS, Super Admin, and Express API

scripts.build:packages: npm --prefix packages/shared-schemas run build && npm --prefix packages/ui run build
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix apps/api run build
scripts.build:org: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix apps/org-admin run build
scripts.build:super: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix apps/super-admin run build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix apps/api run build
